title: Priority 2 Batch 4 Global Immigration Pathways Claim-to-Evidence Audit

pathways.why_important: Europe's #1 skilled work immigration route. Lowered 2026 salary threshold (€45,300 standard / €41,041 bottleneck & new entrants) with fast-track permanent residence in 21-27 months.
pathways.primary_official_authority: Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF) / Make it in Germany
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Bilateral reciprocity fees and third-country appointment queues vary by local diplomatic mission.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: €45,300 gross/yr (standard) / €41,041 gross/yr (STEM, doctors, IT & new entrants)

pathways.why_important: Core direct employment route for qualified specialists with vocational training or university degrees under expanded German Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetz.
pathways.primary_official_authority: Federal Employment Agency (Bundesagentur für Arbeit - BA) / Ausländerbehörde
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Federal Employment Agency (BA) labor approval required unless exempt by occupation or salary.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: Wage parity with domestic workers (comparable local collective bargaining rates)

pathways.official_visa_name: Passeport Talent - Salarié qualifié / Entreprise innovante (CESEDA Art. L421-9)
pathways.immigration_category: Talent Passport - Qualified Employee (Passeport Talent - Salarié qualifié)
pathways.why_important: Flagship skilled corporate employment visa in France with multi-year 4-year validity and immediate full work rights for spouse.
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Requires French employment contract > 3 months and strict gross salary verification (2x SMIC).

pathways.official_visa_name: Autorización de Residencia para Profesionales Altamente Cualificados (Ley 14/2013 Art. 71)
pathways.immigration_category: Highly Skilled Professional Permit (Profesionales Altamente Cualificados - PAC)
pathways.why_important: Fast-track corporate immigration under Ley 14/2013 with 20-working-day administrative turnaround and positive administrative silence.
pathways.primary_official_authority: Unidad de Grandes Empresas y Colectivos Estratégicos (UGE-CE) / Ministerio de Inclusión
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Corporate sponsor must meet UGE-CE business profile criteria or demonstrate strategic importance.

pathways.official_visa_name: Visto de Residência para Atividade Altamente Qualificada (Lei n.º 23/2007 Art. 61.º / 61.º-A)
pathways.immigration_category: Highly Qualified Activity Visa (Visto D3 - Atividade Altamente Qualificada)
pathways.why_important: Primary direct skilled employment residence route in Portugal leading to European citizenship in 5 years.
pathways.primary_official_authority: Agência para a Integração, Migrações e Asilo (AIMA) / Ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros (MNE)
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Initial 120-day double-entry consular visa requires in-person AIMA biometrics appointment in Portugal.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: €1,800-€2,000/mo (at least 1.5x national gross average salary or 3x IAS)

pathways.why_important: Top skilled corporate route in Italy completely exempt from annual Decreto Flussi quota restrictions.
pathways.primary_official_authority: Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione (Prefettura / Ministero dell'Interno)
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Requires electronic Nulla Osta clearance via Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione prior to consular visa issue.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: €34,000+ gross/yr (at least 1.5x gross average annual salary)
pathways.fast_track_processing_days: 30-60 days for Nulla Osta + consular processing

pathways.why_important: Premier European startup entrepreneurship visa backed by recognized facilitators and seamless transition to self-employment.
pathways.primary_official_authority: Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND Netherlands) & RVO (Netherlands Enterprise Agency)
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Mandatory formal agreement with an RVO-recognized facilitator and innovative business plan vetting.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: Independent living funds: ~€1,650/mo minimum liquid capital proof

pathways.immigration_category: H-1B Specialty Occupation Worker Nonimmigrant Visa
pathways.why_important: Globally highest-demand professional specialty occupation visa in the U.S. with dual intent recognition and AC21 multi-year extensions.
pathways.primary_official_authority: United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) / Department of Labor (DOL) / DOS
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Subject to annual statutory 85,000 lottery cap (unless cap-exempt employer) and certified DOL LCA prevailing wage.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: DOL certified prevailing wage for specific SOC occupation and geographic area of employment
pathways.fast_track_processing_days: 15 calendar days with Premium Processing (Form I-907) / 60-120 days standard

pathways.immigration_category: Federal Skilled Worker Program (FSWP) - Express Entry
pathways.why_important: The world's benchmark direct economic permanent residence program under Express Entry, conferring immediate PR on arrival.
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Competitive Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) cutoffs; requires CLB 7 and minimum 67/100 points on 6 selection factors.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: Settlement funds proof ($14,690+ CAD for single applicant, scaling with family size)
pathways.fast_track_processing_days: 6 months target standard processing from e-APR submission

pathways.immigration_category: Employer Nomination Scheme (ENS) Subclass 186 Permanent Visa
pathways.why_important: Australia's premier employer-sponsored permanent residence route with direct 2-year transition from Subclass 482.
pathways.existing_duplicate_check_result: Verified distinct: zero overlap with existing 50 pathways.
pathways.expected_verification_limitations: Age cap under 45 years (strict exemptions); mandatory employer nomination approval and market salary parity.
pathways.statutory_salary_threshold: At least Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT AUD $79,423/yr) and Annual Market Salary Rate
pathways.fast_track_processing_days: 3-6 months for Temporary Residence Transition / 6-12 months for Direct Entry
